blocks.text: The retreat hardens into a running battle in which Afghan tactics fail to restore control. Many a strategy did the Pathan soldiers adopt, but armored men and horses alike are broken by the Singh's mighty swords as the Khalsa keeps closing the distance.

The page stresses how precarious Abdali's situation becomes. Impossible indeed it became for them to reach Kabul in peace, because every march segment invites another Sikh strike and every delay deepens the appearance of imperial weakness.

In response Abdali looks for reinforcement and coordination. Jahan Khan is brought forward to support the battered force, but even with additional leadership and planning, in no way would the Singhs allow him a safe passage back across Punjab.
